text:
I can't say. The evidence for ASSET-K is insufficient because the satellite data it needs hasn't been prepared for this property. No observation was made for the 2021-01-01 to 2025-12-31 period. None of the three sources (Hansen Global Forest Change, JRC GFC2020, MGAP 2021) were available.

This means the evidence doesn't show that no tree-cover loss occurred, and it doesn't show that loss did occur. It also supports no regulatory finding, so it can't label the asset EUDR-compliant, non-compliant, or deforestation-free.

To answer the question, the missing source coverage would need to be prepared and the assessment re-run over the whole asset boundary. This reflects what was known as of 2026-11-12.
